✦ About Me

Hi, I'm Anaiya 👋

I've been a seller at heart for as long as I can remember. When I was just 4 years old, I set up a little table outside Trader Joe's and sold my very first painting to a stranger. I didn't have a business plan — I just had a stack of paintings and a whole lot of confidence. That one sale changed everything for me. I knew right then that I was meant to do this.

Now I'm 10 years old, in 4th grade, and I'm still at it — bigger and better than ever. Over winter break, I visited my friend in Vancouver and we sold over 100 bracelets together in just one week. I didn't know anyone there. I dealt with all kinds of people — some super sweet, some not so nice — but I never stopped. Selling is just in my blood, and every "no" makes the next "yes" even sweeter.

Now I design and sell my own handmade bracelets — macramé, beads, heishi, stacking sets, you name it. Every single piece is made with love, and there's no better feeling than watching someone's face light up when they find the perfect one.

Royal Beads is my dream, my hustle, and my happy place. From a 4-year-old selling paintings on the sidewalk to running my own jewelry brand — this is only the beginning 🤍

Privacy Policy

1. Information We Collect
When you create an account, we collect your first name, email address, and password. When you place an order, we collect your shipping address and payment information (processed securely through PayPal).

2. How We Use Your Information
Your information is used solely to process and fulfill your orders, maintain your account and order history, and communicate with you about your purchases. We will never sell, share, or distribute your personal information to third parties.

3. Data Storage
Your account information and order history are stored locally in your browser. This means your data stays on your device and is not transmitted to external servers (except payment processing through PayPal).

4. Payment Security
All payments are processed through PayPal's secure payment system. Royal Beads does not store or have access to your credit card or bank account information.

5. Your Rights
You can view, update, or delete your account at any time. Clearing your browser data will remove all stored account information.

6. Contact
For privacy questions, reach out via the Beadline page.
